title: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
mechanism: Add a persistent Spatiotemporal Graph-style validator layer to chitta's recall/tool pipeline: before a tool-proposed action/answer is accepted, cross-check it against structured evidence (triplets/task_state) and geometric/logical feasibility, storing failure annotations for reuse, analogous to HarnessVLN's Harness validating planner proposals against spatial evidence and subgoal consistency

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already has contradiction/conflict detection (detect_contradictions, conflict_inspector) and outcome-ledger fail-open logging but no pre-action validator that blocks/corrects a proposed tool action against stored evidence before execution, unlike HarnessVLN's harness-gates-planner design

cost.scope: chitta-mcp/server.py tool-call dispatch, field_memory_recall.cpp evidence lookups, new validator module

evidence.claim: HarnessVLN's Harness validates planner proposals against spatial evidence, geometric feasibility, and subgoal consistency before execution
It maintains a persistent Spatiotemporal Graph with failure annotations for verification and recovery
